iconicAnchor.label: San Francisco psychedelic concert posters
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The movement's concert posters establish near-illegible elastic lettering, dense figure-ground integration, optical vibration, saturated complementary color, and countercultural event context.

sources.title: Victor Moscoso
sources.publisher: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art
supports: Moscoso's documented work anchors vibrating complementary color, warped integrated lettering, dense surface, and music-poster scale in the San Francisco scene.

sources.title: Art of Noise: Design Amplified
sources.publisher: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art
supports: Music graphics connect sound, venue, youth culture, print circulation, and experimental typography rather than functioning as free-floating decoration.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches display type, vivid chroma, dense, print signal, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/psychedelic-poster/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
